description: Defines the DataObjects_Preferences class for interacting with the 'preferences' database table, including methods for auditing and retrieving account ownership information.

classes.name: DataObjects_Preferences
classes.description: Represents the preferences table with methods for auditing and account ownership.

methods.name: staticGet
methods.description: Retrieves a static instance of Preferences based on key and value.

methods.name: _auditEnabled
methods.description: Indicates that auditing is enabled for this object.

methods.name: _getContextId
methods.description: Returns the preference ID as the context identifier.

methods.name: getOwningAccountIds
methods.description: Returns account IDs that own audit trail entries, currently only the admin account.

methods.name: _buildAuditArray
methods.description: Builds an audit array with the preference name as description.
